categories.title: Ancient Magic Hotspot
categories.info: Interact with the Ancient Magic Hotspot to spawn bubbles; gather them all to complete the challenge and increase your Ancient Magic meter capacity.

categories.title: Bandit Camp
categories.info: Bandit Camps house some loot, guarded by a number of Dark Wizards.

categories.title: Beast Den
categories.info: After completing The Elf, the Nab-Sack and the Loom, you can visit Beasts Den to rescue Magical Beasts. Tend to them in the Room of Requirements to obtain their corresponding materials.

categories.title: Creature Lair
categories.info: Creature Lairs contain a large amount of their respective creature.

categories.title: Floo Flame
categories.info: Floo Flames are Fast Travel points, accessible from anywhere on the map.

categories.title: Hamlet
categories.info: Hamlet are little settlement spread through the Highlands. They often contain shops, NPCs and quests.

categories.title: Hedge Maze
categories.info: Hedge Mazes appear randomly, and always contain a lore note and a Legendary Chest at the end.

categories.title: Merlin Trial
categories.info: Merlin Trial are magical puzzles, that often require a specific spell to solve. They can be started by spending a Marrowsweet Leaf on top of the swirl pattern.

categories.title: Treasure Vault
categories.info: Treasure Vaults are small, locked dungeons that contain gear or loot.

categories.title: Vendor
categories.info: Vendors sell various items, tools and gear for the player to purchase. They also buy gear off the player.

categories.title: Balloon
categories.info: Balloons appear high in the air; fly through all of them on a broom or mount to complete.

categories.title: Conjuration
categories.info: Conjurations are decorations for the Room of Requirements. They are found in hexagonal Collection Chests.

categories.title: Demiguise Statue
categories.info: After completing The Caretaker's Lunar Lament, you can collect Demiguise Moons by approaching the statues at night. Trade theses statues in to the Caretaker to upgrade the Alohomora Spell.

categories.title: Field Guide Page
categories.info: Field Guide Pages are hidden everywhere. Collecting one grants 80 XP and adds it to the collection log.

categories.title: Landing Platform
categories.info: Land on Landing Platforms from a broom or a mount to activate them.

categories.title: Trait
categories.info: Trait are upgrades that can be placed on Extraordinary and Legendary gear in the Room of Requirements. They are found in rectangular Collection Chests, and are randomized for each player.

categories.title: Wand Handle
categories.info: Wand Handles are decorations for your character's wand. They are found in cylindrical Collection Chests.

categories.title: Chest
categories.info: Chests can contain a variety of items, such as galleons, Wiggenweld potions or gear. Large and Locked chests always contain gear. Contents are randomized from player to player.

categories.title: Eye Chest
categories.info: Eye Chests can be opened after learning the Disillusionment Charm; approach the chest without being seen to open it.

categories.title: Legendary Chest
categories.info: Legendary Chests contain a legendary piece of gear, scaled to your level.

categories.title: Infamous Foe
categories.info: Infamous Foes are formidable, over-leveled enemies.

categories.title: Butterflies
categories.info: Follow the Butterflies to a Treasure Chest!

categories.title: Lock
categories.info: Locks are unlocked with the Alohomora spell, acquired after The Caretaker's Lunar Lament. Level II and III locks require completion of The Man Behind the Moons.

locations.title: Ancient Magic Hotspot
locations.description:
**Location:** On top of the ruined tower.  
**Bubbles locations:**
- On the stairs landing, just behind the starting point;
- In the ruined castle, south of the bandit camp. Use a Fire spell to burn away the vine-covered archway.
- On the 2nd floor of the castle; use the ladder beside the 2nd bubble.

locations.title: Ancient Magic Hotspot
locations.description:
**Location:** In the ruined building's courtyard.  
**Bubbles locations:**
- In a clearing, between the two paths to the southwest.
- In the clearing, just south of the path leading east.
- On top of the stone chimney of the ruined building.

locations.title: Ancient Magic Hotspot
locations.description:
**Location:** In front of the ruined castle.  
**Bubbles locations:**
- Past the vine-covered archway; use any Fire Spell to burn them away.
- In an alcove, in the room just underneath the first; use Confringo to blow the wooden cover and drop down.
- In a secret alcove, in that same room; use Accio on the statue in the corner to open the alcove. Warning: doing so will spawn Inferi in the room.

locations.title: Ancient Magic Hotspot
locations.description:
**Location:** In the middle of the ruins.  
**Bubbles locations:**
- In a barred room to the southeast; enter from the outside wall by blowing up the crates.
- In a room high in the ruins; start by climbing the broken wall to the south.
- In a barred room in the middle; fly on your broom into it.

locations.title: Ancient Magic Hotspot
locations.description:
**Location:** In the middle of the ruins; must activate the Incendio plate just north using the cube in the northern cart beforehand.  
**Bubbles locations:**
- In the ruined tower, just east.
- Near the landing platform.
- At the end of the Troll Lair

locations.title: Ancient Magic Hotspot
locations.description:
**Location:** In front of the vine-covered archway.  
**Bubbles locations:**
- In the first room, underneath the wooden structure; destroy the barrels to access.
- Bring the block near the scaffolding to climb the ruins. Then, move the block out of the way.
- From there, climb to the top of the ruins, then jump to the opposite side.

locations.title: Ancient Magic Hotspot
locations.description:
**Location:** In front of the ruined building.  
**Bubbles locations:**
- On the 2nd level of the ruined building. Open the door using Alohomora I, then blow away the wooden barricade.
- From the main room, burn away the vines to reveal a block. Bring the block on the eastern side, then climb on the 2nd story. Jump on the platform to pick up the bubble.
- From the 2nd bubble, climb the ladder and crouch under the rafters.

locations.title: Ancient Magic Hotspot
locations.description:
**Location:** In front of the main gate of the building.  
**Bubbles locations:**
- On the 2nd floor of the building; use the ladder next to the main gate, then burn away the foliage to reveal a doorway;
- Next to the first one, on top of a few wooden platforms.
- Behind the main gate; from the first bubble, shoot the pulley and drop down.

locations.title: Ancient Magic Hotspot
Ancient Magic Hotspot
locations.description:
**Location:** In front of the 4 Toad Statues, at the entrance of the ruins.  
**Bubbles locations:**
- Beyond the 2nd Toad Statue, on top of a ramp;
- On a wooden platform on top of the ruins; use your broom to fly and grab it.

locations.title: Ancient Magic Hotspot
locations.description:
**Location:** Under the southern archway.  
**Bubbles locations:**
- Use Reparo on the rubble to the north. Then, jump on the wooden platform.
- Jump on the next level and use Accio on the switch to lower the platform. Kill the goblins guarding the area; the bubble is behind a Level III Lock.
- On a rowboat under the bridge.

locations.title: Ancient Magic Hotspot
locations.description:
**Location:** In front of the lone gravestone  
**Bubbles locations:**
- On the 1st floor, behind the metal grate. Use Depulso on the switch behind the boxes to open.
- Climb on the boxes in the southwestern corner to climb up the rafters. Then, use Depulso on the switch to raise the pillar all the way up to the bubble.
- From the same rafters, head to the northern side of the building. Use Reparo on the planks to repair the scaffolding and acces the final bubble.

locations.title: Ancient Magic Hotspot
locations.description:
**Location:** In front of the ancient ruins.  
**Bubbles locations:**
- In a small vine-covered room, just west past the entrance.
- Above the stone archway; access from the boxes just east past the entrance.
- At the end of the path, by the Treasure Vault entrance.

locations.title: Ancient Magic Hotspot
locations.description:
**Location:** Just before the bridge leading to the ruins.  
**Bubbles locations:**
- In the southeastern building of the ruins. Start by entering the black door in the southwestern building. Crouch under the debris, then use Lumos to enter the vine-covered room.
- From the 1st bubble, burn away the vines on the southern wall and Accio the switch to reveal a hidden block. Climb on the block onto the wooden platform above.
- In the smaller building to the northeast. Destroy the wooden barricade and jump to the higher platform.

locations.title: Ancient Magic Hotspot
locations.description:
**Location:** Next to the Merlin Trial, in front of the ruins.  
**Bubbles locations:**
- In the northwestern building; burn away the vines, then crawl under the boxes.
- On the 2nd level of the southwestern building. From the 1st bubble, climb the ladder in the first room. Then, Accio the switch to raise the platform and access the next building.
- From the 2nd bubble, climb the ladder.

locations.title: Ancient Magic Hotspot
locations.description:
**Location:** Next to the road by the archway with the tower on it  
**Bubbles Locations:**
- On the scaffolding on the wall right near the start
- Keep climbing up from the previous one next to a chest
- South east of the chest next to the previous one break the hanging box and jump to it

locations.title: Ancient Magic Hotspot
Ancient Magic Hotspot
locations.description:
**Location:** On top of the wooden scaffolding, in the center of the ruins.  
**Bubbles locations:**
- Behind the metal doors to the south; use Depulso on the switch to open them.
- In the roof of the northern-most building. Burn away the vines covering the small archway to the northwest, then bring the platform near the wooden scaffolding to climb it.
- Outside the ruins, to the west. Use the nearby ladders covered by vines.

locations.title: Ancient Magic Hotspot
locations.description:
**Location:** At the entrance of the manor.  
**Bubbles locations:**
- On the 2nd floor. Confringo the wooden ceiling to blow it, making a block fall. Then, Levioso the block and use it to climb above the barrels.
- From the 1st bubble, follow the planks to a vine-covered path leading outside. Burn away the vines and follow the scaffoldings to the bubble.
- From the 2nd bubble, follow the planks to a locked door (Alohomora II). Take the Frog Statue beyond the door to the final bubble.

locations.title: Ancient Magic Hotspot
locations.description:
**Location:** At the bottom of the ruined tower.  
**Bubbles locations:**
- Halfway up the tower is a vine-covered archway; burn away the vines and follow the scaffoldings.
- In the entrance archway leading to the bandit camp;
- At the top of the tower

locations.title: Solved By The Bell
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Get the "Musical Map" from Henrietta's Hideaway.

**Solution:** There are nine bells in a zigzag pattern. If number 1 is the **bottom left** bell, number 2 is the **bottom right** bell and so on, then number 9 is the **top left** bell.  
Use your basic cast on the bells in this order: 2 - 5 - 7 - 6 - 5 - 9 - 8 - 6.

**Rewards:** Treasure Seeker's Longcoat.
